entries.name: Anatomy
entries.content:
SeaWings are one of the seven dragon tribes. Anemone is a SeaWing, along with all of her family members. SeaWings are characterized by generally short builds, long and thick tails, bioluminescent plates on top of their scales, and gills. They also have webbed feet and webbed spines going down their back. 

SeaWings cannot breathe fire, and they have no natural breath weapon. Their only weapons are their talons, their teeth, and the large tails that they can use as clubs.
